summary: Tool-call with embedded model invocation billed twice (generation + embedding line items)
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports an unexpected invoice where a single user action (chat request that uses a tool integration) appears as two billable lines: one for text-generation tokens and one for embeddings tokens. The customer is certain the embeddings were produced by an internal tool invoked as part of the same request (used for semantic lookup) and expects those downstream internal calls to be excluded from external usage metering.

Impact:
- NimbleDocs saw a $12,340.52 line item on invoice INV-2026-031 for what they believe are duplicate counts from the same end-user traffic over a 72-hour window.
- This is causing an outage in their budgeting flow while they pause features that rely on tool-call embedding.

Environment:
- Production org: org_9a8bcd (NimbleDocs)
- API key last 4: ****-3c9f
- Region: us-east-1
- Customer uses a hosted account with some dedicated capacity for peak workflow.

Steps to reproduce (as provided by customer):
1) Client issues a chat completions request that triggers a tool call to the customer's internal vector-search service.
2) The tool integration invokes Redwood embed endpoint /v1/embeddings to vectorize the query for lookup, using the same API key/session.
3) The chat response is streamed back to the user.
4) Customer observes invoice lines: 
   - generation tokens: 3,412,780 tokens (charged at hosted rate)
   - embeddings (open-embed-512): 3,412,780 tokens (charged at embedding rate)
5) They assert the embed tokens are internal and should be treated as non-billable internal tool invocations.

Expected behavior:
- Internal tool invocations (calls marked as internal by the tooling layer or using an internal header) should not be double-counted toward the customer-facing usage bill. If a generation request triggers an internal embed for the same user action, the usage pipeline should either de-duplicate or mark the downstream call as internal and exclude from invoice aggregation.

Observed behavior:
- The metering pipeline has produced two separate usage events and they were both ingested into the billing aggregator, resulting in duplicate-style billing.

Relevant logs / artifacts (customer provided):
- Sample request ids: req_20260305_chat_9f3b, req_20260305_embed_9f3b (timestamps 2026-03-05T14:22:11Z and 2026-03-05T14:22:11Z)
- Invoice: INV-2026-031 (line items: LI-88921-generation, LI-88922-embedding)
- Exported usage CSV attached (customer_embed_dup_20260305.csv)
- Customer-supplied trace: https://sentry.example/trace/org_9a8bcd/req_20260305_chat_9f3b

Notes on scope:
- Customer indicates ~95% of the affected events follow the same tool integration pattern (chat -> internal embed -> search -> respond). This appears linked to a recent tool-calling SDK release (v1.4.2) that changed how the embed call is routed (uses same API key and does not set X-Redwood-Internal header).
comments: 2026-03-05 15:01 - Melanie Ortega (Support): Customer opened ticket after receiving provisional invoice with unexpected embed line. Provided CSV and request IDs. Asked for immediate review and temporary mitigation (block feature if needed).
2026-03-05 16:20 - Arjun Patel (Metering): Acknowledged. Assigned to metering pipeline oncall. Requested retention of raw ingestion logs for 72 hours and sample producer hostnames.

2026-03-06 09:12 - SRE (Priya Menon): Initial investigation: ingestion pipeline shows two distinct usage events for the two request IDs. Both carry org_id org_9a8bcd and the same api_key tag. There's no internal-label on the embed call. Hypothesis: SDK v1.4.2 removed the internal header causing embed calls not to be filtered.

2026-03-07 11:45 - Billing (Hassan Li): Crosschecked invoice: both usage events were accepted by the billing aggregator and mapped to separate product SKUs (generation vs embeddings). Created provisional credit request to hold final invoice payment while we investigate.

2026-03-08 14:30 - Engineering (Arjun Patel): Reproduced locally with SDK v1.4.2. Confirmed embed subcalls are made with the same API key and lack an internal marker. Filed PR to patch SDK default to set X-Redwood-Internal for tool-initiated internal calls (see related_github_prs).
2026-03-10 10:05 - Support (Melanie Ortega): Customer requests ETA for credit and asks whether a rollback is necessary. Asked for recommended temporary mitigation for production.

2026-03-12 18:22 - Arjun Patel (Engineering): Temporary mitigation: advise customer to upgrade SDK to patched build 1.4.3-beta which sets internal header for tool-invoked embed calls, or set header manually: "X-Redwood-Internal: true". Also requested billing-run hold until 2026-03-14.
investigation_notes: Ingestion trace shows duplicate ingestion events at the same timestamp with two event types (generation, embeddings) and identical session and api_key metadata.
SDK change-log: v1.4.2 removed default internal header when tool calls are proxied. Reproducer attached to PR #588.

Billing aggregator accepts per-event product classification based on model field and event_type. No de-dupe across product types currently implemented. Need design doc to decide de-dup or internal-label exclusion policy.
Risk: any customer using tool-calls that invoke downstream Redwood endpoints could be affected until SDKs set internal header consistently.
resolution: Workaround provided: customer upgraded to SDK 1.4.3-beta or can set X-Redwood-Internal: true on downstream embed calls to prevent billing ingestion. Engineering fix merged to usage-pipeline (PR 588) to respect internal header during ingestion. Billing has created a provisional credit placeholder for invoice INV-2026-031 while we run a reconcilation. Follow-ups: (1) Run backfill job to identify and adjust duplicate events across invoices for org_9a8bcd between 2026-03-04 and 2026-03-07, (2) Add a rule in aggregator to ignore events carrying internal=true, (3) Publish SDK patch notes and notify other enterprise customers.
next_steps: Run a backfill recon job targeting org_9a8bcd and invoices from 2026-03-04 to 2026-03-07 to generate adjustment lines and issue credit memo.
Deploy usage-pipeline change to honor X-Redwood-Internal header in prod (rollout plan and canary in us-east only).
Coordinate with Billing to apply credit to INV-2026-031 and confirm with customer.
